content.name: Hungry Sequence
content.description:
Iahub 和 Iahubina 去一家豪华餐厅约会。一切进展顺利，直到需要为食物付款。服务员不收钱，而是要求 Iahub 写出一个由 $n$ 个整数构成的 Hungry 数列。

一个包含 $n$ 个整数的数列 $a_{1}$，$a_{2}$，...，$a_{n}$，被称为 Hungry 数列，当且仅当：

- 序列中的元素是严格递增的。即对于任意两个下标 $i, j$ 满足 $i < j$，都有 $a_{i} < a_{j}$。
- 对于任意 $i < j$，$a_{j}$ 不能被 $a_{i}$ 整除。

Iahub 遇到了麻烦，于是请求你帮忙。请你找到一个包含 $n$ 个元素的 Hungry 数列。
content.formatI: 输入包含一个整数：$n$（$1 \leq n \leq 10^5$）。
content.formatO:
输出一行，包含 $n$ 个用空格分隔的整数 $a_{1}$ $a_{2}$ ... $a_{n}$，表示一个可能的 Hungry 数列。注意，每个 $a_{i}$ 都必须满足 $1 \leq a_{i} \leq 10000000$。

如果有多个解，你可以输出其中任意一个。

en.name: Hungry Sequence
en.description:
Iahub and Iahubina went to a date at a luxury restaurant. Everything went fine until paying for the food. Instead of money, the waiter wants Iahub to write a Hungry sequence consisting of $ n $ integers.

A sequence $ a_{1} $ , $ a_{2} $ , ..., $ a_{n} $ , consisting of $ n $ integers, is Hungry if and only if:

- Its elements are in increasing order. That is an inequality $ a_{i}<a_{j} $ holds for any two indices $ i,j $ $ (i<j) $ .
- For any two indices $ i $ and $ j $ $ (i<j) $ , $ a_{j} $ must not be divisible by $ a_{i} $ .

Iahub is in trouble, so he asks you for help. Find a Hungry sequence with $ n $ elements.
en.formatI: The input contains a single integer: $ n $ ( $ 1<=n<=10^{5} $ ).
en.formatO:
Output a line that contains $ n $ space-separated integers $ a_{1} $ $ a_{2} $ , ..., $ a_{n} $ $ (1<=a_{i}<=10^{7}) $ , representing a possible Hungry sequence. Note, that each $ a_{i} $ must not be greater than $ 10000000 $ ( $ 10^{7} $ ) and less than $ 1 $ .

If there are multiple solutions you can output any one.
